definition_zh: 分析师；化验员；系统分析师；精神分析师；评论分析者
definition_en: a person whose work is to examine data, substances, systems or situations and explain what they mean
core_image: 一个人把成堆的数字摊开，用笔在关键处画圈
scene: 金融市场收盘后，办公区的灯还亮着，屏幕上是一排排起伏的曲线。 The analyst stayed late to explain why the share price had fallen.
sceneCN: 这里 analyst 是「分析师」（第 1 个义项：以分析数据、解释走势为职业的人）；句意为这位分析师留下来解释股价为何下跌。画面里有收盘后的办公区、屏幕上成排的曲线与伏案的人。

pos.zh: 名词：分析师；化验员；系统分析师；精神分析师；评论分析者

derivatives.zh: 本词的基础名词，义为「分析；分析结果」，由希腊语 analysis 借入
由同一词族反推而成的动词，义为「分析；化验」；美式拼写为 analyze
由形容词语干加后缀构成，义为「分析的；善于分析的」
由同一词干加复数后缀构成，义为「数据分析学；分析技术」

senses.title: A finance or business analyst
senses.definition: a professional who studies market data, accounts or business performance and gives judgments or forecasts
senses.definitionCN: 研究市场数据、账目或经营表现并作出判断或预测的专业人士
senses.example: The analyst stayed late to explain why the share price had fallen.
senses.exampleCN: 这位分析师留下来解释股价为何下跌。
senses.why: Finance reduces a company to figures, and someone must loosen those figures into trends, so the person takes the noun of the act.
senses.whyCN: 金融把一家公司化成一堆数字，需要有人把这些数字拆成趋势，于是做这件事的人沿用了「分析」这个名词。

senses.title: A laboratory analyst
senses.definition: a person who tests samples in a laboratory and reports what they contain
senses.definitionCN: 在实验室检验样本并报告其成分的人
senses.example: The analyst found traces of copper in the river sample.
senses.exampleCN: 化验员在河水样本中发现了微量铜。
senses.why: Chemical work is the oldest literal kind of analysis, so the job title keeps the laboratory image.
senses.whyCN: 化学工作是最古老的字面「分析」，因此这个职称保留了实验室的意象。

senses.title: A systems analyst
senses.definition: a person who studies how a computer or business system works and designs improvements
senses.definitionCN: 研究计算机或业务系统如何运作并设计改进方案的人
senses.example: A systems analyst mapped the old records system before replacing it.
senses.exampleCN: 一位系统分析师在替换旧档案系统之前，先把它梳理清楚。
senses.why: A system is a complex whole of components, and this job is to take it apart before rebuilding.
senses.whyCN: 系统是由部件构成的复杂整体，这份工作就是在重建之前先把它拆开看。

senses.title: A psychoanalyst
senses.definition: a therapist trained to explore a patient's unconscious thoughts and feelings
senses.definitionCN: 受过训练、探究病人潜意识想法与情感的治疗师
senses.example: Her analyst helped her trace the fear back to childhood.
senses.exampleCN: 她的精神分析师帮她把这种恐惧追溯到童年。
senses.why: The mind is treated as layered, and this profession loosens the layers rather than measuring them.
senses.whyCN: 心灵被当作有层次的结构，这个职业做的是把层次松开，而不是去测量它。

senses.title: A commentator who explains events
senses.definition: a journalist or observer who explains political or social events by separating causes and effects
senses.definitionCN: 通过区分原因与结果来解释政治或社会事件的记者或观察者
senses.example: One political analyst described the vote as a quiet warning.
senses.exampleCN: 一位政治评论分析员把这次投票称作一次无声的警告。
senses.why: Public events are tangled, and an analyst untangles them into causes, motives and likely outcomes.
senses.whyCN: 公共事件是一团缠结，分析者把它拆成原因、动机与可能的后果。

intro.en: Analyst is a French coinage from the Greek noun for analysis, and the word spread as analysis spread into new fields.
intro.cn: analyst 是法语用希腊语「分析」名词造出的词，随着分析进入各个领域而扩散。

items.en: Greek analysis meant 'a dissolving, a resolution into parts', from analyein 'to loosen up'.
items.cn: 希腊语 analysis 意为「分解、解析成部分」，来自 analyein「松开」。

items.en: French formed analyste from analyse plus the person suffix -iste; the word named someone skilled in analysis.
items.cn: 法语用 analyse 加表示人的后缀 -iste 造出 analyste，指擅长分析的人。

items.en: English borrowed the French word; the early use was learned and often mathematical. The exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语借入这个法语词；早期用法偏学术，常与数学相关，确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Chemistry and psychoanalysis gave the word two strong professional homes: the laboratory analyst and the analyst on the couch.
items.cn: 化学与精神分析给了这个词两个稳固的职业归属：实验室化验员，以及躺在诊椅旁的分析师。

items.en: Finance, computing and journalism added finance analyst, systems analyst and political analyst to the family.
items.cn: 金融、计算机与新闻业又加入金融分析师、系统分析师与政治评论分析员。

note.en: The look-alike group is the analysis family; the near-meaning group gathers people who study and explain rather than separate parts.
note.cn: 形近组收 analysis 这一词族；近义组收研究与解释类职业，侧重说明而非拆解。

entries.definition: The noun for the act or result of separating something into parts.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「分析；分析结果」，指拆解整体的动作或结论。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to examine something by breaking it into parts.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「分析；化验」，指把整体拆开来研究。

entries.definition: Adjective: characterized by careful separation and reasoning.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「分析的；善于分析的」，指有条理地拆解与推理。

entries.definition: The field of computational data analysis.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「数据分析学」，指用计算手段分析数据的领域。

entries.definition: Someone with special knowledge; broader than analyst and not tied to any method.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「专家」，指具有专门知识的人，范围比 analyst 更宽，不限定方法。

entries.definition: A person who explains and judges events for an audience, often in media.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「评论员」，指向公众解释与评断事件的人，多见于媒体。

entries.definition: A person who investigates a subject systematically, often producing new data.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「研究者」，指系统探究某课题的人，常亲自产出新数据。

entries.definition: Someone who watches events closely and reports what they see, without formal analysis.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「观察者」，指密切注视事件并报告所见的人，未必做正式分析。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the French person suffix and the three professional homes the word acquired.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用法语中表示人的后缀，以及这个词后来获得的三个职业归属。

normal.en: Analysis plus -ist: the person who performs the loosening.
normal.cn: analysis 加 -ist：做「拆解」这件事的人。

normal.en: French -iste is the same suffix that gives artist and dentist.
normal.cn: 法语 -iste 也是构成 artist 与 dentist 的那个后缀。

normal.en: The lab analyst tests a sample; the finance analyst tests a company.
normal.cn: 实验室分析师检验样本，金融分析师检验一家公司。

normal.en: Systems analyst takes a system apart before rebuilding it.
normal.cn: 系统分析师在重建之前先把系统拆开。

normal.en: Political analyst separates causes from results for the public.
normal.cn: 政治评论分析员替公众把原因与结果分开。

abstract.en: Picture a person at a long table covered with printouts, one finger tracing a line that nobody else noticed.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人坐在长桌前，桌上铺满打印稿，一根手指沿着别人没注意到的曲线移动。

abstract.en: Picture a translator between numbers and people: the numbers speak first, the analyst says what they mean.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人站在数字与人之间做翻译：数字先说话，分析师说出它们的意思。

abstract.en: Picture a magnifying glass held over a map that looks ordinary until a route appears under it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只放大镜压在一张看似普通的地图上，直到一条路线在镜下滑现。

examples.en: The analyst stayed late to explain why the share price had fallen.
examples.cn: 这位分析师留下来解释股价为何下跌。

examples.en: The analyst found traces of copper in the river sample.
examples.cn: 化验员在河水样本中发现了微量铜。

examples.en: One political analyst described the vote as a quiet warning.
examples.cn: 一位政治评论分析员把这次投票称作一次无声的警告。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安呢历史」——安安静静地翻旧账，把历史数据拆开来看：分析师

root: 希腊语 analysis「分解」经拉丁语进入学术语言，法语加表示人的后缀 -iste 造成 analyste，指擅长分析者。英语十七世纪借入，十九至二十世纪在化学与精神分析中获得稳固职业义，现代又扩展到金融、计算机与新闻评论。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses are one job title spreading through five workplaces: finance, the laboratory, computing, the therapy room, and the news desk.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项是同一个职称扩散到五个工作场所：金融、实验室、计算机、治疗室与新闻台。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person holds a magnifying glass over a table of figures and points out the hidden line.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人拿着放大镜俯看成堆数字，指出别人看不见的那条线。

branches.en: THE MARKET LINE: figures become trends, and the analyst explains the movement of prices.
branches.cn: 市场线：数字变成趋势，分析师解释价格的走向。

branches.en: THE LABORATORY LINE: a sample is separated into measurable components.
branches.cn: 实验室线：样本被分离成可测量的成分。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM LINE: a complex machine or process is mapped before it is rebuilt.
branches.cn: 系统线：复杂的机器或流程在重建之前先被梳理清楚。

branches.en: THE MIND LINE: the therapist loosens the layers of the unconscious.
branches.cn: 心灵线：治疗师把潜意识的层次松开。

branches.en: THE PUBLIC LINE: events are untangled for an audience into causes and outcomes.
branches.cn: 公众线：替听众把事件拆成原因与结果。

intro.en: Analyst is the Greek analysis noun plus the French person suffix -ist; the rest of the family keeps the analytic stem.
intro.cn: analyst 是希腊语 analysis 名词加法语表示人的后缀 -ist；词族其余成员保留 analytic 词干。

latinIntro.en: Latin analysis and analyticus are documented Greek borrowings, and the French analyste is recorded, so nothing here is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 analysis 与 analyticus 是有文献的希腊借词，法语 analyste 也有记录，因此这里没有重构形式。

items.exampleCN: 它加强词根中「松开」的动作。

items.example: It is the deepest root of the family.
items.exampleCN: 它是这一词族最深的词根。

items.example: It is the base noun of the job title.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个职称的基础名词。

definition_zh: 钻石；菱形；方块牌
definition_en: a very hard clear precious stone, or a shape with four equal sides
core_image: 黑绒布上放着一颗石头，灯一照，四面都射出细光
scene: 珠宝店的柜台上铺着黑绒，一颗石头被灯照着，四面都在闪。 The diamond on the ring caught the light.
sceneCN: 这里 diamond 指「钻石」（第 1 个义项：一种极硬而透明的宝石）；句意是戒指上那颗钻石接住了灯光。

collocations.zh: 未经琢磨的钻石；外粗内秀的人

senses.title: A hard clear gem
senses.definition: a very hard clear precious stone used in jewellery
senses.definitionCN: 一种极硬而透明的贵重宝石，用于首饰
senses.example: The diamond on the ring caught the light.
senses.exampleCN: 戒指上那颗钻石接住了灯光。
senses.why: The hardest thing in the room is also the one that breaks light into pieces.
senses.whyCN: 屋里最硬的东西，也最会把光拆成碎片。

senses.title: A four-sided shape
senses.definition: a shape with four equal straight sides and two pairs of equal angles
senses.definitionCN: 四边相等、两对角分别相等的一种图形
senses.example: The tiles were laid in a diamond pattern.
senses.exampleCN: 瓷砖被铺成菱形图案。
senses.why: A square tipped onto one corner looks like a cut gem.
senses.whyCN: 一个方框用角立起来，就像一颗切好的宝石。

senses.title: The card suit
senses.definition: one of the four suits in a pack of cards, marked with a red diamond
senses.definitionCN: 一副纸牌中四种花色之一，以红色菱形为标记
senses.example: He played the ace of diamonds and won the trick.
senses.exampleCN: 他打出方块 A，赢了这一墩。
senses.why: A gem can become a small red mark on a card.
senses.whyCN: 一颗宝石，能变成纸牌上的一个小红记号。

intro.en: Diamond comes from Greek adamas, the unconquerable, through Latin and Old French, and it has always named the hardest stone.
intro.cn: diamond 来自希腊语 adamas（不可征服的），经拉丁语与古法语进入英语，一直指最硬的石头。

items.en: Adamas meant unconquerable, built from a- and daman, to tame.
items.cn: adamas 意为不可征服，由 a-（不）与 daman（驯服）构成。

items.en: The stone was named for its refusal to be cut or worn down.
items.cn: 这种石头因不肯被切开、被磨损而得名。

items.en: Latin adamas shifted toward the form diamans.
items.cn: 拉丁语 adamas 渐渐变成 diamans 这一形式。

items.en: French diamant gave English its spelling and its jewellery sense.
items.cn: 法语 diamant 给了英语拼写，也给了首饰这层意思。

items.en: The shape and the card suit borrowed the same pointed figure.
items.cn: 菱形与纸牌方块借用了同一个带尖角的图形。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the diamond stem, while the meaning group names other precious stones.
note.cn: 形近组共用 diamond 这个词干，近义组则指其他几种贵重石头。

entries.definition: a snake with diamond markings
entries.definitionCN: 身上有菱形花纹的蛇

entries.definition: hard and bright like a diamond
entries.definitionCN: 像钻石一样硬而亮的

entries.definition: decorated with small sparkling stones
entries.definitionCN: 用小亮石装饰的

entries.definition: a cut stone of high value
entries.definitionCN: 切磨过的高价值石头

entries.definition: a precious stone set in metal
entries.definitionCN: 镶在金属上的宝石

entries.definition: clear mineral with a regular shape
entries.definitionCN: 形状规则而透明的矿物

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a stone on black cloth and end with a red mark on a playing card.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从黑布上的一颗石头开始，落到纸牌上的一个红记号。

normal.en: The Greek name meant unconquerable, and the stone still refuses the knife.
normal.cn: 那个希腊名字意为不可征服，这颗石头至今也不肯让刀。

normal.en: Diamond is a shape as well as a stone: a square standing on one toe.
normal.cn: diamond 既是石头也是形状：一个踮着一只脚的方框。

normal.en: The card suit keeps the gem as a small red rhombus.
normal.cn: 纸牌花色把那颗宝石留成了一个小小的红菱形。

normal.en: Hard things also make the best windows for light.
normal.cn: 坚硬的东西，也最会给光开窗。

normal.en: A rough diamond is a person worth cutting.
normal.cn: 未经琢磨的钻石，说的是一个值得打磨的人。

abstract.en: Picture a stone with many flat faces.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗有许多平面的石头。

abstract.en: Picture a ring held up against a lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚戒指被举到灯前。

abstract.en: Picture four white bases in dry grass.
abstract.cn: 想象干草地上四个白色的垒包。

examples.en: The diamond on the ring caught the light.
examples.cn: 戒指上那颗钻石接住了灯光。

examples.en: The tiles were laid in a diamond pattern.
examples.cn: 瓷砖被铺成菱形图案。

examples.en: He played the ace of diamonds and won the trick.
examples.cn: 他打出方块 A，赢了这一墩。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diamond 记成「带个蒙的」：dia 是穿过，mond 像「芒」，光穿过石头射出光芒，那就是钻石。

root: 来自希腊语 adamas（不可征服），经拉丁语与古法语 diamant 进入英语。本义是坚硬到不肯被切割的宝石，后来也指被切成菱形的东西，并用于纸牌的方块花色与棒球场的内场。

sensesIntro.en: From the hardest stone, to the shape of a cut gem, to a small red mark on a card.
sensesIntro.cn: 从最硬的石头，到切好宝石的形状，再到纸牌上的一个小红记号。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a clear stone with many flat faces throwing light in all directions.
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗有许多切面的透明石头，把光射向四面八方。

branches.en: The first sense is the stone itself and its value.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是石头本身以及它的价值。

branches.en: The second sense is the outline of the cut stone.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是切好的石头的外轮廓。

branches.en: The third sense is that outline reduced to a card symbol.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是那个轮廓缩小成纸牌符号。

branches.en: The gem and the rhombus share one pointed figure.
branches.cn: 宝石与菱形，共用同一个带尖的形状。

branches.en: A floor pattern and a card suit both repeat a small diamond.
branches.cn: 地面图案与纸牌花色，都在重复一个小菱形。

intro.en: Diamond has a small family built on hardness, brightness and the pointed shape.
intro.cn: diamond 有一小族词，建在坚硬、明亮与尖角形状上。

latinIntro.en: The Greek base means unconquerable, and the family keeps that sense of something that will not yield.
latinIntro.cn: 它的希腊词基意为不可征服，这一族词保留着「不肯屈服」的意思。

definition_zh: 不；不是（no 的口语否定回答）
definition_en: an informal spoken word used to say no or give a negative answer
core_image: 随口一弹的「不」：嘴唇轻合再张开，干脆利落地挡回一个请求
scene: 朋友问要不要再来一杯，他摆了摆手，把杯子推远了些。 Nope, I have had enough coffee for today.
sceneCN: 这里 nope 是「不、不用了」（第 1 个义项：口语的否定回答）；句意是「不用了，今天咖啡我喝够了」。

derivatives.zh: nope 的正式对应词，义为「不；不是」
同为口语否定答语，义为「不」，语气比 nope 更随意
nope 的口语肯定对应词，义为「是的」

senses.title: A casual spoken no
senses.definition: an informal word used in speech to refuse, deny, or disagree
senses.definitionCN: 口语中用来拒绝、否认或不同意的非正式说法
senses.example: Nope, that seat is already taken.
senses.exampleCN: 不行，那个座位已经有人了。
senses.why: The core image is a flicked-off refusal — the informal shape of the word no itself.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是被随手弹开的拒绝——它就是 no 这个词的非正式形态。

senses.title: A flat denial of a guess
senses.definition: a quick reply rejecting a suggestion or guess made by someone else
senses.definitionCN: 快速回应、否定别人提出的建议或猜测
senses.example: Is this your bag? Nope, mine is the red one.
senses.exampleCN: 这是你的包吗？不是，我的是红色的那个。
senses.why: A guess aims at a target, and the short word knocks it away in one beat.
senses.whyCN: 猜测像射向目标的箭，而这个短词一拍就把箭挡飞。

senses.title: Closing a question with humor
senses.definition: a playful or emphatic way to end a question or request, often with a shrug
senses.definitionCN: 俏皮或加重语气地结束一个问题或请求，常伴随耸肩
senses.example: Can I borrow your car? Nope, not a chance.
senses.exampleCN: 能借你的车吗？门儿都没有。
senses.why: Because it is casual, nope carries a light tone that softens or jokes about refusal.
senses.whyCN: 因为口语随意，nope 自带轻松语气，能把拒绝说得俏皮或不那么生硬。

intro.en: Nope is an informal extension of no, apparently formed in spoken American English; its exact origin is uncertain.
intro.cn: nope 是 no 的口语扩展形式，一般认为形成于美式口语；其确切来源不确定。

items.en: The base word no comes from Old English na, meaning never or no, built from ne (not) plus a (ever).
items.cn: 基底词 no 来自古英语 na（从不；不），由 ne（不）加 a（曾经）构成。

items.en: No settled into English as the standard negative answer to questions.
items.cn: no 在中古英语时期定型，成为回答问题的标准否定词。

items.en: Nope first appears in writing in the late nineteenth century, generally believed to be a spoken extension of no; the reason for the final -p is uncertain.
items.cn: nope 最早见于十九世纪末的文字记录，一般认为是 no 的口语扩展形式；词尾 -p 的成因不确定。

items.en: Alongside nah and yep, nope spread as the casual counterpart of no and yes in conversation.
items.cn: 与 nah、yep 一道，nope 作为 no 与 yes 的随意对应词在日常对话中流行开来。

items.en: Today nope is common in speech, texting, and informal writing, keeping its light, dismissive tone.
items.cn: 如今 nope 常见于口语、短信与非正式书面语，仍保持轻松、随口打发人的语气。

note.en: Nope clusters with other short answer words; watch the spelling and the register differences.
note.cn: nope 与其他短答语聚在一起，需注意拼写与语体的差别。

entries.definition: the standard negative answer, formal or neutral
entries.definitionCN: 标准否定答语，正式或中性场合用；nope 是它的口语变体

entries.definition: to be gloomy and idle
entries.definitionCN: 抑郁消沉；只是拼写与 nope 相近，词源完全不同

entries.definition: to wish for something to happen
entries.definitionCN: 希望；拼写仅一个字母之差，词义相反方向，词源不同

entries.definition: an even more casual spoken no
entries.definitionCN: 比 nope 更随意的口语「不」，常见于年轻人对话

entries.definition: a formal no, used in voting
entries.definitionCN: 正式的「反对」票用语；与 nope 语体相反

entries.definition: the casual spoken yes, opposite of nope
entries.definitionCN: 口语的「是的」，是 nope 的直接反义对应词

normalIntro.en: Anchor nope to its base word no and to its casual answer-word family.
normalIntro.cn: 把 nope 锚定在基底词 no 及其随口答语词族上。

normal.en: nope = no + a popped ending; it is simply no said with a bounce.
normal.cn: nope 就是 no 加一个弹出的尾音，本质是带着弹性说出的 no。

normal.en: Remember the pair: nope answers no questions, yep answers yes questions.
normal.cn: 记住配对：nope 对应否定回答，yep 对应肯定回答。

normal.en: nah and nope are cousins — both informal, both refuse quickly.
normal.cn: nah 和 nope 是表亲——都很随意，都用来快速拒绝。

normal.en: In voting the formal word is nay, not nope; keep the registers apart.
normal.cn: 投票场合的正式词是 nay 而非 nope，注意语体区分。

normal.en: Texting uses nope a lot — one syllable, one complete refusal.
normal.cn: 短信里 nope 很常用——一个音节，一次完整的拒绝。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pushing a plate gently away while the mouth says nope.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把盘子轻轻推开，同时嘴里说着 nope。

abstract.en: Hear the word bounce like a small ball hitting a wall and rolling back — refusal rebounds.
abstract.cn: 把这个词听成小球撞墙弹回——拒绝被弹了回去。

abstract.en: See a shoulder shrug attached to the word: nope travels with a lifted shoulder.
abstract.cn: 想象这个词总伴随一个耸肩：nope 是跟着耸肩一起出发的。

examples.en: Do you want more rice? Nope, I am full.
examples.cn: 还要再来点米饭吗？不用了，我饱了。

examples.en: He asked if the shop was open, and she just said nope and walked on.
examples.cn: 他问商店开没开门，她只说了声「不」就继续走了。

examples.en: Nope, I have never been to that city.
examples.cn: 不，我从没去过那座城市。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「诺普」——嘴上说「诺」，心里却「扑」地一下拒绝掉，谐音联想 nope 即随口说的「不」。

root: nope 不是词根构词的产物，而是 no 的口语扩展形式；一般认为形成于十九世纪末的美式英语，词尾 -p 的来源不确定。基底词 no 源自古英语 na（ne「不」+ a「曾经」）。

sensesIntro.en: From a bounced-off refusal, nope grows into quick denials of guesses and playful closings of requests.
sensesIntro.cn: 从随手弹开的拒绝出发，nope 发展出对猜测的干脆否定和对请求的俏皮回绝。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a refusal flicked away in one beat, the casual shape of no
core.cn: 核心意象：一拍弹开的拒绝，no 的随口形态

branches.en: the basic informal no in speech
branches.cn: 口语中基本的非正式否定

branches.en: knocking away a guess in one beat
branches.cn: 一拍挡回别人的猜测

branches.en: humor and shrug softening the refusal
branches.cn: 俏皮与耸肩让拒绝变轻

branches.en: casual register shared with nah and yep
branches.cn: 与 nah、yep 共享的随意语体

branches.en: short answers that close conversations fast
branches.cn: 迅速结束对话的短答语

intro.en: Nope is not built from prefixes or suffixes; it belongs to the small family of clipped and extended answer words.
intro.cn: nope 不由前后缀构成，它属于截短与扩展型答语词的小家族。

latinIntro.en: No Latin root applies here; the family comes from Old English and later spoken English, so the Latin list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 此处不涉及拉丁词根；该词族源自古英语与后世的英语口语，拉丁同族词列表为空。

items.example: No is the neutral base; nope is its casual form.
items.exampleCN: no 是中性基底，nope 是它的随意形态。

items.example: Nah, I will skip the meeting.
The motion failed with forty nays.
items.exampleCN: 动议以四十票反对未获通过。

items.example: Yeah, I saw the film last week.
items.exampleCN: 对，我上周看了那部电影。

items.example: No way am I lending him money again.

derivatives.zh: 不；不是
不（比 nope 更随意）

definition_zh: 完全地；全然；总共；合计；总而言之
definition_en: completely, with everything counted, or when the whole situation is considered
core_image: 把散落的东西全部拢到一处，堆成一个整体
scene: 搬家那天，纸箱从楼上一直堆到门口。 There were eleven boxes altogether, and not one of them was labelled.
sceneCN: 这里 altogether 是「总共」（第 2 个义项：把各项加在一起来算）；句意为总共有十一个箱子，而且一个都没有贴标签。画面里是堆到门口的纸箱。

pos.zh: 副词：完全地；总共；总而言之

derivatives.zh: 本词的后半部分，来自古英语 tōgædere，是同源成分而非由本词派生
分开写的短语，义为「大家一起」，与本词的单字拼写形成对照，并非派生词

senses.title: Completely, entirely
senses.definition: used to emphasize that something is entirely the case, with no exception or reserve
senses.definitionCN: 用来强调某事完全如此，没有例外也没有保留
senses.example: The mood in the room was altogether different after the news.
senses.exampleCN: 听到消息后，屋里的气氛完全不同了。
senses.why: Together gathers things into one place and all adds completeness, so the whole is entirely one thing with nothing left out.
senses.whyCN: together 把东西收到一处，all 又添上「全部」，合起来就是整体上一点不剩，于是表示「完全地」。

senses.title: In total, counting everything
senses.definition: when everything is counted or included, with nothing omitted from the sum
senses.definitionCN: 把所有东西都算进去、一点也不漏时的总数
senses.example: The trip cost us about two thousand yuan altogether.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅行我们总共花了大约两千元。
senses.why: Count items into one heap, and the adverb answers the question of how many there are in all.
senses.whyCN: 把一项项数进同一堆里，这个副词回答的就是「加起来一共多少」，所以表示「总共」。

senses.title: On the whole
senses.definition: used when a judgment is made about a whole situation after everything has been considered
senses.definitionCN: 把各方面都考虑过之后，对整个局面作出判断时使用
senses.example: Altogether, it was a difficult year but a useful one.
senses.exampleCN: 总的来说，这是艰难的一年，也是有收获的一年。
senses.why: Look at the heap as one object instead of as separate parts, and the adverb turns into a summary judgment.
senses.whyCN: 不去看堆里的每一件，而是把整堆当成一个对象来看，这个副词就从「合计」转为对整个局面的总结。

senses.title: In the altogether
senses.definition: in the informal phrase in the altogether, wearing no clothes at all
senses.definitionCN: 用于非正式短语 in the altogether，表示身上什么衣服都没穿
senses.example: The toddler escaped from the bath and ran through the hall in the altogether.
senses.exampleCN: 那孩子从浴缸里跑出来，光着身子穿过走廊。
senses.why: The whole body is taken as one undivided whole, and the phrase becomes a playful way of saying naked.
senses.whyCN: 把整个身体当作一个不可分割的整体，这个短语就成了「一丝不挂」的委婉而带玩笑味的说法。

intro.en: Altogether is a native compound of all and together, two words that were later written as one.
intro.cn: altogether 是 all 与 together 的本族语复合词，原本是两个词，后来写成了一个。

items.en: Eall meant all, and tōgædere meant in one company; the ancestor of together already carried the idea of gathering into one place.
items.cn: eall 意为「全部」，tōgædere 意为「聚在一处」；together 的祖形已经带有「收拢到一处」的意思。

items.en: Al together was still written as two words and meant both all in one group and in total.
items.cn: al together 仍写作两个词，既表示「大家聚在一处」，也表示「合计」。

items.en: The two words merged into the single spelling altogether, while the group sense was increasingly written all together; exact dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 两个词合并成单字拼写 altogether，「聚在一处」的意思则越来越多写作 all together；确切年代不确定。

items.en: In emphatic use the sense in total shaded into entirely, and the completive meaning became established.
items.cn: 在强调用法里，「合计」的意思逐渐滑向「全然」，表示「完全」的用法就此确立。

items.en: The phrase in the altogether for being naked is recorded in the nineteenth century, and careful writing keeps all together for the group sense.
items.cn: 表示赤身裸体的短语 in the altogether 在十九世纪有记录；严谨的写作仍用分开的 all together 表示「聚在一起」。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words built on together and the easily confused two-word phrase; the near-meaning group holds adverbs of completeness and summing up.
note.cn: 形近组收由 together 构成的词以及容易混淆的分写短语；近义组收表示「完全」与「总括」的副词。

entries.definition: In one place or group, with others; the second half of altogether.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「一起、共同」，是 altogether 的后半部分。

entries.definition: A two-word phrase meaning everyone in one group; it looks like altogether but has a different meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 分开写的短语，义为「大家聚在一起」；它看起来像 altogether，意思却不同。

entries.definition: The noun for the feeling of closeness within a group.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「团聚感、亲密无间」，由 together 加 -ness 构成。

entries.definition: To the fullest degree, with nothing missing; the most neutral of the completive adverbs.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「完全地」，是这类副词里最中性的一个。

entries.definition: Wholly, as a single undivided whole.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「整个地、全然」，强调作为一个不可分割的整体。

entries.definition: Completely, often in formal or legal writing.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「完全地」，多用于正式或法律文本。

entries.definition: Considering everything; a summary view that keeps the parts in sight.
entries.definitionCN: 副词或形容词，义为「总体上」，是仍看得见各部分的总结视角。

entries.definition: Completely, common in speech and often emphatic.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「完全地」，口语常用，语气往往更强。

normalIntro.en: These hooks pull the compound apart and use the phrases that keep the word alive.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子把这个复合词拆开，并利用让它保持活力的几个搭配。

normal.en: Break it as all plus together: everything gathered, nothing left out.
normal.cn: 把它拆成 all 加 together：东西全拢在一起，一件也没落下。

normal.en: Together is the second half, so the word still pictures things in one heap.
normal.cn: 后半部分是 together，所以这个词仍然画着「东西堆成一堆」的画面。

normal.en: Altogether different means completely different, not all together in one place.
normal.cn: altogether different 意为「完全不同」，不是「全都在一处」。

normal.en: Written apart, all together means everyone in one group; written as one word, altogether means completely or in total.
normal.cn: 分开写 all together 指大家聚在一起；写成一个词 altogether 则表示完全或总共。

normal.en: In the altogether is a set phrase for having no clothes on.
normal.cn: in the altogether 是一个固定短语，指身上没穿衣服。

abstract.en: Picture scattered boxes pushed with a broom into one pile against the wall.
abstract.cn: 想象用扫帚把散落的箱子一路推到墙边，堆成一堆。

abstract.en: Once they are one pile, you can count them, and you can also step back and judge the pile as a whole.
abstract.cn: 堆成一堆之后，你既能数清它们，也能退后一步对整堆作出评价。

abstract.en: The same heap read as a quantity gives in total, and read as a shape gives completely.
abstract.cn: 同一堆东西，当作数量来读就是「总共」，当作一个形态来读就是「完全」。

examples.en: The two sisters look altogether different, yet their voices are alike.
examples.cn: 姐妹俩看起来完全不同，声音却很像。

examples.en: Altogether, the repairs will take about three weeks.
examples.cn: 总共算下来，维修大约要三周。

examples.en: It was not altogether a failure, though little of the plan survived.
examples.cn: 这并不完全是失败，尽管计划几乎没剩下什么。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥拓盖德」——把东西全扫成一堆再数：总共、完全

root: 由 all 与 together 复合而成，中古英语写作 al together 两个词；together 来自古英语 tōgædere，其中 to- 表「到、向」，gædere 表「聚在一处」。合写后兼有「总共」与「完全」两义，而「大家一起」仍写作 all together。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of altogether move from one heap to a judgment: entirely, in total, on the whole, and the fixed phrase for being naked.
sensesIntro.cn: altogether 的四个义项都围绕「一堆」展开：完全地、总共、总而言之，以及表示赤身裸体的固定说法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: everything scattered is swept into one pile against the wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：散落的东西被扫到墙边，拢成一堆。

branches.en: THE WHOLE: the pile is viewed as one undivided thing, so nothing is excepted.
branches.cn: 整体线：把整堆看成一个不可分割的东西，所以一点例外都没有。

branches.en: THE COUNT: the same pile is counted item by item, and the adverb gives the sum.
branches.cn: 计数线：同一堆东西逐件来数，这个副词给出的就是总数。

branches.en: THE JUDGMENT: stepping back from the pile turns the sum into a verdict on the whole.
branches.cn: 评判线：从堆边退后一步，总数就变成了对整个局面的评语。

branches.en: THE BODY: the whole body taken as one unit gives the playful phrase for naked.
branches.cn: 身体线：把整个身体当成一个单位，就有了「一丝不挂」那个玩笑式的说法。

branches.en: THE COUNTERPART: the two-word all together keeps the group sense, so the single word now reads mainly as a sum or a verdict.
branches.cn: 对照线：分开写的 all together 保留了「聚在一起」的意思，单字拼写的本词于是主要读作合计或评语。

intro.en: Altogether is a native compound, so its parts are whole Old English words rather than prefixes and roots.
intro.cn: altogether 是本族语复合词，它的组成部分是完整的古英语词，而不是前缀与词根。

latinIntro.en: Both halves are Germanic, with no Latin ancestor, so no Latin cognates are listed.
latinIntro.cn: 两个部分都属于日耳曼语，没有拉丁语祖形，因此不列拉丁同源词。

items.example: It is the first part of the compound.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个复合词的第一部分。

items.example: It is the shape the first element took in Middle English.
items.exampleCN: 这是第一个成分在中古英语里的形态。

items.example: It is the second part of the compound.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个复合词的第二部分。

items.example: It is the first element of tōgædere.
items.exampleCN: 它是 tōgædere 的第一个成分。

items.example: It is the second element of tōgædere.
items.exampleCN: 它是 tōgædere 的第二个成分。

items.example: The two words fused into one spelling.
items.exampleCN: 两个词融合成一个拼写。

items.example: It keeps the group sense that the single word lost.
items.exampleCN: 它保留了单字拼写丢掉的那层「聚在一起」的意思。

definition_zh: 有效的；生效的；实际的
definition_en: producing the result that is wanted, officially in force, or real in practice rather than only in name
core_image: 一把钥匙正好对上锁孔，门一下就开了
scene: 新规定贴出后，门口的长队当天就短了一半。 The new rule proved effective from its first morning.
sceneCN: 这里 effective 是「有效的」（第 1 个义项：能产生预期结果）；句意是新规从第一个早晨起就被证明有效。

pos.zh: 形容词：有效的；生效的；实际的

forms.label: 比较级（形容词，多音节用 more）
最高级（形容词，多音节用 most）

derivatives.zh: 由本词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「有效地；实际上」
由本词加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「有效性」
由本词加否定前缀 in- 构成，义为「无效的」
与本词同源，义为「奏效的；有效力的」

senses.title: Producing the wanted result
senses.definition: producing the result that was intended or wanted
senses.definitionCN: 能产生预期或想要的结果
senses.example: The vaccine is effective against the new strain.
senses.exampleCN: 这种疫苗对新毒株有效。
senses.why: Effective adds -ive to effect: the thing has the power to leave the result you aimed at.
senses.whyCN: effective 是 effect 加 -ive：这件东西有能力留下你瞄准的那个结果。

senses.title: Officially in force
senses.definition: officially starting to apply, as a law, rule or agreement
senses.definitionCN: 法律、规则或协议等正式开始适用
senses.example: The ban is effective from 1 June.
senses.exampleCN: 该禁令自 6 月 1 日起生效。
senses.why: A rule that is in effect is effective: the same done thing, now described as having force.
senses.whyCN: in effect 的规则就是 effective：同一件做成之事，换了个说法强调它有力。

senses.title: Real in practice
senses.definition: existing or acting in fact, even if not officially recognized
senses.definitionCN: 事实上存在或起作用，即使未获正式承认
senses.example: She has effective control of the budget.
senses.exampleCN: 她对预算拥有实际控制权。
senses.why: What works in practice is real, so effective also means actual rather than nominal.
senses.whyCN: 在实践中起作用的就是真实的，因此 effective 也指实际上的，而非名义上的。

intro.en: Effective is effect plus the Latin adjective ending -ivus, which French passed on as -if.
intro.cn: effective 是 effect 加拉丁语形容词词尾 -ivus，法语把它传成 -if。

items.en: Effectus, a thing done, supplied the noun stem for the adjective.
items.cn: effectus（做成之事）为形容词提供了名词词干。

items.en: Effectivus meant producing a result, and it named the power to bring something about.
items.cn: effectivus 意为「能产生结果的」，指促成某事的力量。

items.en: French effectif kept the sense of producing an effect and also of being real in fact.
items.cn: 法语 effectif 既保留「能产生效果」的意思，也指「事实上的」。

items.en: English borrowed the adjective and used it for measures, medicines and rules.
items.cn: 英语借入这个形容词，用于措施、药物与规则。

items.en: The official-force sense settled in legal and business use, beside the practical sense.
items.cn: 「正式生效」一义在法律与商务用法中固定下来，与实践义并存。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the effect family; the near-meaning group separates efficient, efficacious and valid.
note.cn: 形近组收 effect 词族；近义组区分 efficient、efficacious 与 valid。

entries.definition: A noun for a result, or a verb meaning to bring something about.
entries.definitionCN: 名词指结果，动词指使某事发生；effective 由它加 -ive 构成。

entries.definition: The adverb of effective, meaning successfully or in practice.
entries.definitionCN: effective 的副词形式，义为「有效地」或「实际上」。

entries.definition: The noun for the quality of being effective.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「有效性」，由 effective 加 -ness 构成。

entries.definition: Working well without waste; it stresses economy of means rather than success alone.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「高效的」，强调不浪费，而不只是成功。

entries.definition: Producing the desired effect, used mostly of medicines and remedies; more formal.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有功效的」，多用于药物与疗法，较正式。

entries.definition: Officially acceptable or legally in force, for documents and rules.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有效的、合法的」，多用于文件与规则。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow one key that fits: it opens the door, it is stamped by an office, and it works even when no one says so.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子跟着一把对得上的钥匙：它开了门、被机关盖了章、没人说明也照样管用。

normal.en: Effective is effect plus -ive: able to leave the result you wanted.
normal.cn: effective 是 effect 加 -ive：有能力留下你想要的结果。

normal.en: A vaccine is effective if the illness does not take hold.
normal.cn: 疫苗有效，就是病没能扎下根。

normal.en: A law becomes effective on a date printed in the text.
normal.cn: 法律在文本里印着的那个日期生效。

normal.en: Effective control is control you actually have, not control on paper.
normal.cn: effective control 是你真正握着的控制权，不是纸面上的。

normal.en: Efficient is about no waste; effective is about the result arriving.
normal.cn: efficient 讲不浪费；effective 讲结果真的到了。

abstract.en: Picture a key that meets its lock exactly.
abstract.cn: 想象一把正好对上锁孔的钥匙。

abstract.en: The same key can open a door, carry an official stamp, or turn a budget.
abstract.cn: 同一把钥匙可以开门、可以带着公章，也可以转动一笔预算。

abstract.en: Effective means the result you aimed at is really there.
abstract.cn: effective 意味着你瞄准的结果真的在那里。

examples.en: The vaccine is effective against the new strain.
examples.cn: 这种疫苗对新毒株有效。

examples.en: The ban is effective from 1 June.
examples.cn: 该禁令自 6 月 1 日起生效。

examples.en: She has effective control of the budget.
examples.cn: 她对预算拥有实际控制权。

dict_mnemonic.text: 词根 effect（做出结果）加 -ive（有……性质的），合起来就是「能做出结果的」

root: 由 effect 加拉丁语形容词词尾 -ivus 构成；effect 又出自 efficere「做出、完成」，核心始终是「做出结果」。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of effective: able to produce the wanted result, officially in force, and real in practice.
sensesIntro.cn: effective 的三个义项：能产生预期结果、正式生效、事实上成立。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a key that meets its lock exactly, so the door opens at once.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把正好对上锁孔的钥匙，门一下就开了。

branches.en: THE RESULT: the key turns and the door really opens.
branches.cn: 结果线：钥匙一转，门真的开了。

branches.en: THE DATE: the same key is stamped to work from a fixed day.
branches.cn: 日期线：同一把钥匙被盖上章，从某天起生效。

branches.en: THE FACT: the key works even if no sign announces it.
branches.cn: 事实线：即使没有告示，钥匙照样起作用。

branches.en: THE TEST: both senses are proved by what actually happens.
branches.cn: 检验线：两个义项都由实际发生的事来证明。

branches.en: THE POWER: a measure can both work and be officially in force.
branches.cn: 效力线：一项措施既可以管用，也可以正式生效。

intro.en: Effective keeps the effect stem and adds Latin and French adjective endings; English then adds adverb and noun endings.
intro.cn: effective 保留 effect 词干，加上拉丁语与法语形容词词尾；英语随后再加副词与名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin effectus and effectivus are recorded, and French effectif is attested, so only the oldest layers are reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 effectus 与 effectivus 均有记录，法语 effectif 也有书证，只有最古老的层次属于重构。
